body: Local files for local documents — blitz-net's file: branch serves a file: document alone; a remote page reads no local file (the founder, 2026-11-12, «Как в коде + работа»)

- blitz-net's `file:` branch (`Provider::fetch_inner`, `packages/blitz-net/src/lib.rs:159-171`) serves a `file:` URL only
  to a request whose loading document is itself a `file:` document; for any other loading document — `http:`, `https:`,
  `data:`, `about:`, a Dioxus document with no URL — it reads nothing from disk and answers an error through
  `NetHandler::error`, so a remote page reads no local file through a stylesheet, an `@import`, an image, a font, an
  `<iframe src>` or any other sub-resource the engine fetches.

- The same rule script loads already keep (`document_may_load`, `packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/fetch.rs:43-46`;
  architecture · decision/file-script-load-refused, security-plan · decision/file-url-only-for-file-documents) now holds for
  the engine's own sub-resource fetches: one predicate, not two that can drift `[inferred]` — where it lives (blitz-traits'
  `net`, beside `Request`, or kept in blitz-vibey-script and re-used) is the plan's.

- The request has to say which document loads it: today `Request` (`packages/blitz-traits/src/net.rs:56`, `#[non_exhaustive]`)
  carries no initiator, and every engine fetch is stamped by one function, `blitz_dom::net::stamped_request`
  (`packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:31`), reached from the seven sub-resource sites (`document.rs:1674`, `iframe.rs:136`,
  `layout/damage.rs:614`, `mutator.rs:1429`, `mutator.rs:1496`, `net.rs:228`, `net.rs:438`) `[inferred]`. A request with no
  loading document — an embedder's own top-level load (the browser's and the markdown viewer's navigation of a `file:`
  path the user named) — keeps loading as today `[inferred]`.

- A `file:` document keeps loading its `file:` sub-resources exactly as today: the browser opening a local HTML file, the
  markdown viewer (`apps/readme`) and the WPT runner reading local fixtures stay green `[inferred]`.
- `data:` and `http(s):` loads are unchanged for every document.

- No path restriction, response-size cap or request timeout is added to the `file:` branch: the security plan's standing
  limit («reads `file:` URLs from disk with no path restriction and has no response-size cap or request timeout») keeps
  holding for a `file:` document, and this chunk narrows only who may reach it.

- Navigation is not a fetch by the page: a link, a form submission or `navigate_to` towards a `file:` URL goes through the
  embedder's `NavigationProvider` and is out of this chunk `[inferred]` — the research names what it reaches.

- The Dioxus `dioxus` scheme served from local files (security-plan · decision/dioxus-scheme-local-files,
  `packages/dioxus-native/src/assets.rs`) is the embedder's own asset path and is not narrowed `[inferred]`.

- The stand and the driver do not use blitz-net (the stand's load page answers through the in-process `LoadNet`): no driver
  verb, argument, key name, result field, cause, session error, exit, carrier, log field or span is added or changed.

- A narrowing for every document, remote pages included — no boundary widening. The refused load's error text holds no
  page content beyond what `NetHandler::error` already carries; no log site, print, env read or panic path is added on the
  refusal.

- blitz-traits `net::Request` (a field or an equivalent the loading document's URL rides on) and, if the predicate moves,
  its home.
- blitz-dom's `stamped_request` and the document's URL it reads (`BaseDocument::url`).
- blitz-net's `Provider::fetch_inner` `file:` arm, and its unit tests (`delivers_network_and_bad_url_errors`).

- The masters at wrap: architecture · decision/file-script-load-refused takes the clause «so a remote page cannot read local
  files» (the relay's item 2); the security plan's `blitz-net` limit and the test plan's file-URL decision restate the
  engine's sub-resource fetches beside the script loads.

- A check, both layout modes where a document is laid out, that a non-`file:` document's stylesheet, image and `<iframe>`
  pointing at an existing local file read nothing from it (the load errors; no style, no image, no sub-document), and that
  a `file:` document's same three loads succeed — through blitz-net's real `Provider`, offline, with no listener `[inferred]`.

- blitz-net's own unit test: a `file:` request whose loading document is `https:` errors, one whose loading document is
  `file:` delivers the bytes, one with no loading document delivers them.

- `8a166d6aa` (the last wrap's flip, HEAD): green · checks 17/17 · wall 1399 s · run CI#43516231087 — nothing to
  disposition.

- The founder's word of 2026-11-12, «Как в коде + работа», and the operator's relay carrying it (item 2 of the
  route adaptation after the landing): close blitz-net's `file:` branch for a document that is not itself a `file:`
  document; at this chunk's wrap the clause «so a remote page cannot read local files» lands on
  decision/file-script-load-refused `[inferred]` — snapped after promotion.

  `NetHandler::error`, so a remote page reads no local file through a stylesheet, an `@import`, an image, a font, an
  `<iframe src>` or any other sub-resource the engine fetches.

- The same rule script loads already keep (`document_may_load`, `packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/fetch.rs:43-46`;

_Generated by /andromeda-phase P4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not
edit during an /implement run._
- **Marker:** 2026-11-13-local-files-for-local-documents · **Version:** escher-0.3.0 · **Generated:** 2026-11-13T23:33:23Z

A remote page reads no local file through the engine's own sub-resource fetches. blitz-net's `file:` branch serves a
`file:` URL only to a request whose loading document is itself a `file:` document, or to a request that names no
loading document — an embedder's own top-level load. A request from any other document (`http:`, `https:`, `data:`,
`about:`, a Dioxus `dioxus://` document) reads nothing from disk and answers its handler's `error`. This is the
founder's word of 2026-11-12, «Как в коде + работа», as relayed (`inputs#I1`). It is a narrowing for every document,
remote pages included, and no boundary widening.

The rule is the one script loads already keep (architecture · decision/file-script-load-refused, security-plan ·
decision/file-url-only-for-file-documents). Its one predicate moves to `blitz_traits::net`, because shared types live
in blitz-traits (architecture · decision/traits-crate-for-interop). blitz-vibey-script keeps `document_may_load` at its
public path as a re-export (architecture · contract/blitz-vibey-script-api/document-may-load).

`Request` (`#[non_exhaustive]`, architecture · decision/non-exhaustive-request-types) gains the loading document's
URL. `Request::get` leaves it unset, so embedders' top-level loads keep loading. blitz-dom stamps the document's URL
on every request it builds. That covers the seven engine fetch sites, all built by `stamped_request` (research §Graph
impact): `build_request` @ `packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:661` (for `reload_resource_by_href` @ `document.rs:1676`,
`load_linked_stylesheet` @ `mutator.rs:1431` and `load_image` @ `mutator.rs:1498`), `start_iframe_load` @
`iframe.rs:138`, `flush_image_layers_from_style` @ `layout/damage.rs:616`, `StylesheetLoader::request_stylesheet` @
`net.rs:230` and `fetch_font_face_rules` @ `net.rs:440`.

A refused load answers through `NetHandler::error`, the path every failed load already takes (architecture ·
contract/net-handler/error, contract/blitz-net-provider/fetch). A refused stylesheet therefore stops blocking render
(security-plan · decision/failed-stylesheet-blocks-no-render), and a settle meets no load left in flight (test-plan ·
decision/failed-load-ends-settle-wait). The refusal adds no log site, print, env read or panic path, and carries no page
content (security S2).

1. **The loading document on a request, and the shared predicate** — `packages/blitz-traits/src/net.rs`.
   - Add one public field to `Request`, `initiator: Option<Url>`, documented as the URL of the document the request
     loads a sub-resource for. `None` means a load no document asked for.
   - `Request::get` sets `initiator` to `None`. Add a builder, `Request::initiator(self, url: Url) -> Self`, beside
     `signal`.
   - Move `document_may_load(document_url: Option<&Url>, url: &Url) -> bool` here, its body and doc comment unchanged
     (`packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/fetch.rs:40-46`). Its doc keeps the reason: «so that remote pages cannot read local
     files».
   - Add a `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` at the end of the file (keeps arch S4, tests S1). It holds one table-driven test
     over the predicate's cases, asserting its row count (tests S4):
     - a `file:` URL for a `file:` document → true;
     - a `file:` URL for an `https:` document → false;
     - a `file:` URL for a `data:` document → false;
     - a `file:` URL for no document → false;
     - an `https:` URL and a `data:` URL for an `https:` document → true.

2. **blitz-vibey-script keeps its public path** — `packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/fetch.rs`.
   - Replace the function's body with a re-export: `pub use blitz_traits::net::document_may_load;`. The crate root's
     `pub use fetch::{…, document_may_load}` (`lib.rs:43`) and every caller (research §Graph impact, 8 references) stay
     as they are.
   - Nothing else in the crate changes.

3. **blitz-net's `file:` arm refuses a non-`file:` loading document** — `packages/blitz-net/src/lib.rs`.
   - In `Provider::fetch_inner`'s `"file"` arm (159), before `to_file_path` and before the `wasm32` branch, check
     whether `request.initiator` is `Some(document)` and `document_may_load(Some(document), &request.url)` is false.
   - If so, return `Err(ProviderError::FileForbidden)` without touching the file system.
   - Add the unit variant `FileForbidden` to `ProviderError`. Its `Display` arm is fixed text with no URL or path in it:
     `file: load refused for a non-file document`.
   - A request with `initiator: None`, or with a `file:` initiator, reads the file as today.
   - Add a test in the inline `mod tests` (keeps tests S1, S3, security S1). It is offline with no listener and reads the
     crate's own `Cargo.toml` through `Url::from_file_path(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/Cargo.toml"))`.
     `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR` is already a registered env read. It checks three requests through the existing `fetch` helper
     path, widened to take a `Request`:
     - one with an `https:` initiator errors with the fixed text;
     - one with a `file:` initiator delivers bytes equal to the file;
     - one with no initiator delivers the same bytes.
   - `delivers_network_and_bad_url_errors` keeps its `file:///dev/null/missing.css` case unchanged.

4. **blitz-dom stamps every request with its document** — `packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs`, `document.rs`, `iframe.rs`,
   `layout/damage.rs`, `mutator.rs`, `cssom.rs`.
   - `stamped_request(url, signal, initiator: &Url)` sets the initiator on the request it builds.
   - Each of its 5 callers passes the URL of the document that loads the resource:
     - `build_request`: `&self.url`, through `DocumentUrl`'s `Deref<Target = Url>`;
     - `start_iframe_load`: the parent document's `&self.url`;
     - `flush_image_layers_from_style`: `&self.url`;
     - `request_stylesheet`: the loader's document URL;
     - `fetch_font_face_rules`: a new `document_url: &Url` parameter.
   - `StylesheetLoader` gains a `document_url: Url` field. It is filled at its 4 construction sites: `cssom.rs:333`
     (`stylesheet_loader()`), `document.rs:1742`, `net.rs:162`, and `net.rs:238` (carried by `..self.clone()`).
   - `StylesheetHandler` gains a `pub document_url: Url` field. It is filled at its 2 construction sites,
     `document.rs:1682` and `mutator.rs:1415`, and passed on when its loaded sheet's `@font-face` rules are fetched
     (`net.rs:391`).
   - The CSSOM `@font-face` insertion (`cssom.rs:516`) passes `&self.url`.
   - No other behaviour moves. Requests are not filtered in blitz-dom: the refusal is blitz-net's alone (§Constraints).

5. **blitz-tests gains the witness's two dev-dependencies** — `tests/blitz-tests/Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock`.
   - Add `blitz-net = { workspace = true }` (default features off, as the workspace declares it) and
     `tokio = { workspace = true, features = ["rt"] }`.
   - The lockfile changes only in blitz-tests' own dependency list. No new package enters it. Check that with
     `git diff Cargo.lock` before any `--locked` gate runs.

7. **Run the gates** (§Test Commands) in order. The integration witness is controlled red-before-green (tests S3):
   - its `http:` assertions read red on the tree with step 3's refusal removed;
   - its stamp assertions read red with step 4's stamping removed.
   implement fires both controls through `gate.py control`. The guards are `packages/blitz-net/src/lib.rs` (the
   `FileForbidden` return in the `file:` arm) and `packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs` (the `initiator` set in
   `stamped_request`).

- `tests/blitz-tests/tests/local_files_for_local_documents.rs` — the witness: the seven paths stamped with their document, and a remote page's local stylesheet, `@import`, image and iframe read through blitz-net's real `Provider` refused while a `file:` page's load, both layout modes
- `packages/blitz-traits/src/net.rs` — `Request.initiator`, its builder, `document_may_load` moved here with its unit test
- `packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/fetch.rs` — `document_may_load` re-exported from blitz-traits
- `packages/blitz-net/src/lib.rs` — the `file:` arm's refusal, `ProviderError::FileForbidden`, its unit test
- `packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs` — `stamped_request`'s initiator; `StylesheetHandler`, `StylesheetLoader` and `fetch_font_face_rules` carry the document URL
- `packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs` — `build_request` and the handler and loader it builds pass the document URL
- `packages/blitz-dom/src/iframe.rs` — `start_iframe_load` stamps the parent document
- `packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/damage.rs` — the CSS image fetch stamps the document
- `packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs` — the linked stylesheet's handler carries the document URL
- `packages/blitz-dom/src/cssom.rs` — `stylesheet_loader()` and the CSSOM `@font-face` fetch pass the document URL
- `tests/blitz-tests/Cargo.toml` — dev-dependencies `blitz-net` and `tokio`
- `Cargo.lock` — blitz-tests' dependency list

The gates run on the dev host, Linux. Nothing boots in this chunk: there is no harness command and no live leg, and the
real boot is /implement P3's.

The diff builds `file:` URLs from paths in a new check. That is OS-sensitive: a path's form on Windows is
`Url::from_file_path`'s. So the plan carries the operator's hygiene, push and CI-read entries. CI's windows and macos
test legs witness the new target and blitz-net's test there.

The base sha in the census and the guard is HEAD as this plan is written,
`8a166d6aa3a368afa57e94f05b30a3237730afc0`.

The stand-repeat and coverage legs are not local entries. CI's «Stand checks repeated» and «Coverage report» jobs run
them, and the operator's CI read asserts `verdict: green`.

body:
## 2026-11-13-local-files-for-local-documents — 5. Integration Test Strategy: 1 row(s)
**Section:** 5. Integration Test Strategy
**Change:** ~ decision/file-urls-only-for-file-documents · guard: was «remote_document_cannot_load_file_urls, file_document_can_load_sibling_file_urls»; now «remote_document_cannot_load_file_urls, file_document_can_load_sibling_file_urls, local_files_for_local_documents»
**Why:** decision/file-urls-only-for-file-documents: the rule now covers the engine's sub-resource loads through blitz-net, and the new blitz-tests target that holds that half in both layout modes guards it beside the script-load checks.
**Ref:** .andromeda/runs/2026-11-14T00-30-46-wrap/
- Consuming builder methods named `with_*` / `without_*` (`with_virtual_time`, `without_timer_thread`), except blitz-traits' `Request` builders, named by their field: `signal` and `initiator`.

- Crate internals are `pub(crate)` / `pub(super)`; the slotmap key is used only at the storage boundary — public APIs use `NodeId`. blitz-dom builds a network `Request` only through its one crate-private constructor, which stamps the loading document as the request's initiator (guarded by blitz-dom's clippy `disallowed-methods` rule on `Request::get`, one local expect of the lint at that constructor).

- Every network `Request` is built only through the crate's one crate-private constructor, which stamps the loading document as the request's initiator (clippy `disallowed-methods` on `Request::get`, one local expect at that constructor). Layout runs over a crate-private `LayoutPassState`, which wraps the document for one pass and carries Taffy's tree traits; `BaseDocument` implements none of them. `collect_layout_children_with_wrap` sets `NodeFlags::IS_INLINE_WITH_ONLY_BLOCK_CHILDREN`, read by the public `Node::is_inline_with_only_block_children`; `render_element` skips such a box's own shadow, background and border through `paints_own_box`, read on a frame by `inline_box_decorations_frame` in both layout modes; an engine change for every document. Every box-generating `::before` / `::after` votes in flow classification (`classify_flow_children`) — an inline-block whose only child is a pseudo exports its line baseline and bottom-aligns, and a grid row grows by the baseline shim of pseudo-only items (`pseudo_element_flow_classification`, each of whose three tests runs both layout modes) — and a text input already focused when its editor is constructed enables IME through `shell_provider.set_ime_enabled(true)` in `create_text_editor`: two upstream engine changes for every document, not counted among escher's direct ones.

- `NetProvider::fetch(doc_id, Request, Box<dyn NetHandler>)` + `is_noop()`; `NetHandler::bytes` and, beside it, `NetHandler::error(self: Box<Self>, url: String, error: String)`, a default that does nothing, which a wrapping handler must forward or the failure stops at the wrapper; `NetWaker`; `Request` (a public `initiator`, the URL of the document a sub-resource is loaded for, `None` for a top-level load, set by the consuming builder `initiator`) / `Body` / `FormData`; `AbortController` / `AbortSignal`.

- **`blitz-net`** — networking: the `Provider` behind `NetProvider::fetch` — HTTP through reqwest, filesystem (a `file:` URL only for a top-level load or a `file:` document, any other refused `FileForbidden` before a disk read), `data:` URIs

- **Embedder drain:** `take_js_errors` / `take_messages` on `ScriptDocument` (≤256 errors retained between drains). A failed fetch in `NetProvider::fetch` logs `Error fetching` and reaches its handler through `NetHandler::error`, a default that does nothing unless the handler overrides it; a stylesheet's handler responds `Err(error)`, so `pending_critical_resources` loses the request and a failed, empty or non-CSS stylesheet stops blocking render, the error text stopping in `ResourceLoadResponse` and the `Resource load failed` line; a bad `href` starts no load, so it reaches no fetch or load line; a `file:` load asked by a non-`file:` document is refused as a typed forbidden error — a script fetch rejects with a TypeError, a module import fails, a script element's source is recorded as a script error, and an engine sub-resource fetch fails with fixed text naming no URL or path, adding no log site.

- **Script execution** → default `ScriptFetcher` accepts only `file:` / `data:`, and a `file:` URL loads only for a `file:` document or a top-level load — `fetch()`, a module `import` and `<script src>` each refused otherwise with a `FetchError` (`document_may_load`, remote pages included; a narrowing); JS `fetch()` is GET/HEAD only through the embedder's fetcher; same-origin / CORS observed absent; every runtime event is `isTrusted`; a page's script also reaches `URLSearchParams` and `URL.prototype.searchParams`, `href` and `search` live both ways, through `url_search_params.js`, the first of ten bootstrap scripts — a realization on the registered script crossing, no boundary widening — its native helper `__blitz_parse_search_params` deleted from `globalThis` before any page script runs; the browser's JS is behind the non-default `javascript` feature.

- `blitz-net` reads `file:` URLs from disk with no path restriction and has no response-size cap or request timeout — do not route agent- or user-supplied URLs through it without a decision recorded in the security plan. A failed load reaches `NetHandler::error`, on the public trait a default that does nothing, so a wrapping implementer that does not forward it compiles and drops the failure silently — forward it. blitz-dom builds a sub-resource request only through the one constructor that stamps its loading document as the initiator (clippy `disallowed-methods` on `Request::get`, the constructor alone under a single `expect`) — keep it so.

- The default `ScriptFetcher` accepts only `file:` and `data:`, and a `file:` URL loads only for a `file:` document or a top-level load (`document_may_load`: JS `fetch()`, a module `import` and `<script src>` each refused otherwise with a `FetchError`, remote pages included — a narrowing); same-origin/CORS checks are absent and every runtime event has `isTrusted = true`. A page's script also reaches `URLSearchParams` and `URL.prototype.searchParams`, `href` and `search` live both ways, through `url_search_params.js`, the first of ten bootstrap scripts — a realization on this registered crossing, no boundary widening; its native helper `__blitz_parse_search_params` is deleted from `globalThis` before any page script runs.

- No mocking library, property-test or snapshot crate is used (blitz-tests carries the assertion crate test-that 0.6.0 with test-that-macro 0.6.0 as dev-dependencies, 0.5.2 until 2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts, whose `verify_that!` and `TestResult<()>` upstream's merged `accessibility_label` and `accessibility_description` checks assert through under the same `#[test]` harness) — stand-ins are hand-written fakes (`RecordingNetProvider` and `ManualNetProvider`, upstream's; escher's one held network stand-in `fixtures::HeldNet`; since 2026-10-20-load-wait `stand_load_wait`'s in-file self-answering `LateNet`, whose `fetch` answers each request from its own thread after a 200 ms sleep; the stand's own `LoadNet`, private to `examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs`, which `stand::boot_load` puts in its options' `net_provider` and which answers the fixed `http://stand.test/load.css` from a thread of its own after `LOAD_ANSWER_DELAY` (200 ms), `is_noop` not overridden; `RecordingShell`, `select_popup`'s own `CountingShell`, blitz-shell's test-local `CountedWakes`, `NoopEventHandler`, probe widgets). A check decodes or encodes a PNG through blitz-tests' `png` dev-dependency, or, in seven_guis, which has none, by a hand base64 reader and the PNG header.
